messages:
Morgan (sec-eng): FYI trivy ran on nightly images and flagged two high/critical CVEs in the base layer used by model-runtime images. SBOM and output below.
sec-bot: automated scan result uploaded: https://scans.internal/redwood/1730005123 (trivy+grype) :warning:
Alejandra (sre): which image tag? is this in prod?
Morgan (sec-eng): image: redwood/model-runtime:2026-02-14-nightly. Currently only deployed to staging and dedicated-canary nodes, not full prod.
David (platform): paste the vuln IDs and package paths pls
Morgan (sec-eng): CVE-2025-2189 - glibc (base layer) - CRITICAL
Morgan (sec-eng): CVE-2024-3344 - libxml2 - HIGH
Morgan (sec-eng): snippet:
```
TRIVY RESULTS: redwood/model-runtime:2026-02-14-nightly
+------------------+----------------+----------+------------------+
| LIBRARY          | VULNERABILITY  | SEVERITY | FIXED VERSION    |
+------------------+----------------+----------+------------------+
| glibc            | CVE-2025-2189  | CRITICAL | 2.34-1~patched   |
| libxml2          | CVE-2024-3344  | HIGH     | 2.9.14-3         |
+------------------+----------------+----------+------------------+
```
Alejandra (sre): if it's only staging/canary we can quarantine the image in the registry and stop pulling it. I'll add a policy flag on the deployment groups.
David (platform): I'll deprecate the tag and set registry flag `blocked=true`. Also trigger a rebuild of model-runtime using patched base.
Liz (product-security): Do we have any builds signed with cosign that now need re-signing? Could be verification break for Dedicated customers.
Morgan (sec-eng): We sign images with cosign using KMS. I'm going to rotate the signing key used for nightly and re-sign patched images. No need to rotate customer-facing keys, only our build key.
sec-bot: ticket created: SEC-2026-97 (supply-chain scan hit) -> https://issues.internal/SEC-2026-97
Alejandra (sre): Action list: 1) Quarantine tag (done by infra) 2) Pin base image to patched version and rebuild 3) Re-run full SCA and SBOM generation 4) Promote only after passing gating scans. I'll own gating changes.
David (platform): Created PR in infra/base-image: bump glibc/libxml2 to patched versions -> https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/812. Kicked off CI rebuild.
Morgan (sec-eng): Local verification shows patched base removes CVE-2025-2189. Re-scan output: 0 critical, 1 medium.
Morgan (sec-eng): Syft SBOM generated and uploaded to artifact store: s3://sboms/redwood/model-runtime/2026-02-14-nightly/sbom.json
Liz (product-security): Please add an SBOM entry for the dedicated pool images and tag the SBOM with sha256 of the image. We'll need that for audits.
Morgan (sec-eng): Done. SBOM now includes image digest and build metadata.
Alejandra (sre): CI gating: adding a job to fail builds if trivy returns any CRITICAL vulns or if severity score >7. I'm adding the job to staging pipeline now.
David (platform): Also adding registry policy to disallow pushes of images with critical CVEs (we'll use Clair/Policy). Rolling change to CI in progress.
Liz (product-security): Post-incident: let's update runbook "supply-chain-scan-hit" with steps: quarantine, rebuild, rescan, SBOM upload, cosign re-sign using KMS, notify customers if dedicated instances affected. I'll open a PR to docs.
Morgan (sec-eng): Notifying customer-facing SREs in case any dedicated customer's images were built from the vulnerable base. Early checks show no dedicated customer images used that base tag.
sec-bot: advisory: images in registry tagged `blocked=true` -> 1 image, 3 manifests.
Alejandra (sre): Any need to rotate KMS keys across prod?
Morgan (sec-eng): No rotation required for prod verification keys. We'll rotate the build/signing key (gcp-kms:projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/nightly) and re-issue attestations. I'll file the key-rotation note in SEC-2026-97.
David (platform): I've scheduled a full image re-scan for all model-runtime tags in the registry. ETA ~12m.
Liz (product-security): Great. Also add SBOM diffing in the Console so we can detect new packages being introduced to base images.
Morgan (sec-eng): Follow-ups: 1) Add SBOM upload step to nightly CI (tracked in infra PR). 2) Add policy to fail on CRITICAL vuln (gated). 3) Runbook PR for supply-chain-scan-hit (I'll co-author with Liz). 4) Postmortem light: short timeline + root cause (outdated base pulled by nightly).
Alejandra (sre): OK closing the loop on containment: registry quarantine active, blocked pulls from canary. Rebuilds passing locally.
Morgan (sec-eng): Closing ticket SEC-2026-97 once SBOM and cosign attestations verified. Will update last_message_ts. :white_check_mark:
Liz (product-security): Thanks everyone. Add me to the postmortem and the runbook PR.
David (platform): Will follow up with infra team to make the registry quarantine automated on future critical detections.
sec-bot: scan-complete: re-scan shows no CRITICAL vulns in promoted images.
Morgan (sec-eng): final: promoted patched image to staging-canary, signs updated, SBOM uploaded, CI gating enabled.
